verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, with the same flaws. The headline breaks one or two words per line, giving a tall, choppy stack. The legal copy is almost as large as the subhead and is jammed against the bottom edge under the CTA. The bottle is squeezed right under the sale banner, which crops at the left edge. The logo is the only difference: in B it is a tiny, almost unreadable SOLSTICE wordmark, while A keeps it slightly larger and more legible.
